## Letters Desk

Position letters filed by the lobby corps — newest first.

```{r letters-feed}
#| results: asis
source("scripts/shared.R")

fl <- form_url("Letters")
if (!is.na(fl))
  cat('<p class="table-note"><a href="', fl, '">File a position letter</a></p>', sep = "")

# Build-time feed (letters reach the site on each build, unlike the Wire,
# which browsers read live). The full sortable table is letters.qmd.
letters <- scan_letters()
bills   <- load_bills()
cat(letters_feed_html(letters, bills, limit = 12))
if (nrow(letters) > 12)
  cat('<p><a class="wire-more" href="letters.html">All ', nrow(letters), ' position letters &rarr;</a></p>', sep = "")
```

:::

## The Organizations

```{r tiles}
#| results: asis
# One square tile per organization, linking to its page: the org's code
# as a monogram on its color, name beneath, spending power (when set) as
# a corner badge.
lobbys <- read.csv(LOBBY_CSV) |> mutate(Code = toupper(Code))

tiles <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(lobbys)), function(i) {
  l <- lobbys[i, ]
  color <- if (!is.na(l$Color) && l$Color != "") l$Color else "#17345a"

  face <- sprintf('<span class="tile-mono">%s</span>', l$Code)

  badge <- if (!is.na(l$Spending.Power) && l$Spending.Power != "") {
    sprintf('<span class="tile-badge">%s</span>', l$Spending.Power)
  } else ""

  sprintf('<a class="tile" style="--tile-color:%s" href="%s/%s.html">%s%s<span class="tile-name">%s</span></a>',
          color, LOBBY_PAGES_DIR, l$Code, badge, face, l$Lobby)
}, character(1))

cat('<div class="tile-grid">', paste(tiles, collapse = "\n"), '</div>')
```

<p class="table-note">A note for students: these are real organizations,
role-played for the simulation. Anything you create for the simulation
outside this site — social-media accounts, posts, flyers, anything public —
must be clearly marked as fictional UC Merced simulation work, so it can
never be mistaken for the real organization.</p>
